purpose: expected values of the offline full chain at factory settings with RNNoise; see test_golden_chain.py

sweep.note: log tone sweep 100 Hz-8 kHz at -23 dBFS peak, 250 ms of silence at each end

noise_bursts.note: four 0.4 s noise bursts (-30 dBFS) in a -66 dBFS floor; the gate opens and closes at each edge

hot_near_clipping.note: the synthetic voice peaking at 0.99 full scale

bench_room_t02.note: the first 4 s of bench mix room-t02

bench_cafe_t02.note: the first 4 s of bench mix cafe-t02

transition_hum_retune.note: voice with mains hum that starts at 50 Hz with a phrase after 1.0 s and moves to 60 Hz with the phrase after 2.5 s; strong input cleanup retunes its notches

transition_rumble_onset.note: voice with low-frequency rumble from 1.5 s; gentle cleanup raises its high-pass

transition_level_step.note: the synthetic voice 24 dB louder from 100 ms into the phrase after 2.0 s; the compressor and automatic makeup follow

transition_sibilant_burst.note: voice with two 0.3 s bursts of 4-11 kHz hiss (-22 dBFS) and the de-esser switched on

transition_limiter_burst.note: a -6 dBFS tone burst from 1.0 to 2.0 s with 12 dB of manual makeup, so the limiter catches it
